message.content: In the conversation, Li Hua mentions a particularly impactful scene from the TV series "Chernobyl." This scene showcases the human spirit and sacrifices made by the workers during the efforts to contain the radiation after the Chernobyl disaster. The scene highlights the confusion and bravery of the people involved, capturing the gravity of the situation with powerful storytelling. Li Hua emphasizes that this scene is very moving and shows the resilience of the individuals facing such a catastrophic event.
